Purification and activation properties of UreD-UreF-urease apoprotein complexes. In vivo assembly of the Klebsiella aerogenes urease nickel metallocenter requires the presence of UreD, UreF, and UreG accessory proteins and is further facilitated by UreE. Prior studies had shown that urease apoprotein exists in an uncomplexed form as well as in a series of UreD-urease (I.-S. Park, M.B. Carr, and R.P. Hausinger, Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. USA 91:3233-3237, 1994) and UreD-UreF-UreG-urease (I.-S. Park and R.P. Hausinger, J. Bacteriol. 177:1947-1951, 1995) apoprotein complexes. This study demonstrates the existence of a distinct series of complexes consisting of UreD, UreF, and urease apoprotein.
